Class MethodAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.example.bluej.MethodAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
bluej.extensions2.event.CompileListener
public class MethodAdapter extends Object implements bluej.extensions2.event.CompileListener
Adapter: after each successful compile the student starts, asks BlueJ for the compiled classes' methods and publishes a EventType.METHOD_ADDED event for each new one. Working out which methods are new is delegated to MethodTracker.

  • Method Details

    • compileSucceeded

      public void compileSucceeded(bluej.extensions2.event.CompileEvent event)
      Called by BlueJ when a compile succeeds. For each compiled file, publishes a METHOD_ADDED event for every method not seen at the previous compile. BlueJ's background checks are ignored.
      Specified by:
      compileSucceeded in interface bluej.extensions2.event.CompileListener
      Parameters:
      event - BlueJ's description of the compile

    • publishNewMethods

      private void publishNewMethods(File javaFile) throws Exception
      Finds the class for a compiled file and publishes its new methods. Methods generated by the compiler (with $ in their name) are skipped.
      Parameters:
      javaFile - the compiled source file
      Throws:
      Exception - if BlueJ cannot provide the class or its methods

    • findClass

      private bluej.extensions2.BClass findClass(File javaFile) throws Exception
      Finds the BlueJ class for a compiled source file, e.g. .../Shapes/Dog.java gives Dog. A class in the same folder as the file is preferred over one with the same name elsewhere.
      Parameters:
      javaFile - the compiled source file
      Returns:
      the matching class, or null if none is found
      Throws:
      Exception - if BlueJ cannot list the open projects or packages
